greeting.label: Greeting
greeting.description: Hellos, goodbyes, how-are-yous. Almost every NPC engages.

small_talk.label: Small talk
small_talk.description: Weather, the harvest, road conditions, generic chatter.

gossip.label: Gossip
gossip.description: Generic rumor exchange not tied to a specific topic below.

the_tower.label: The old tower
the_tower.description: The ruin north of Marlow's Hollow. Many briefings cluster here.

the_dragon.label: The dragon
the_dragon.description: Sightings, rumors, fears, lore. The bounty's nominal subject.

quest_status.label: The bounty
quest_status.description: Asking about the reeve's posted job, payment, terms.

bandits.label: Bandits
bandits.description: The recent bandit presence north of the village.

forest.label: The forest
forest.description: General questions about the woods, paths, dangers, wildlife.

the_drake.label: The drake
the_drake.description: Iskar. What he is, whether he's safe, what villagers make of him.

gold_eyed_one.label: The gold-eyed one
gold_eyed_one.description: The phrase from the bandit note. Almost no one knows it.

the_reeve.label: Reeve Halden
the_reeve.description: The village's representative of the Crown.

personal_history.label: NPC's own past
personal_history.description: Asking the NPC about themselves: where they come from, what they did.

jorin_theft.label: Jorin's stolen coin box
jorin_theft.description: The vegetable-theft event in the square (flavor; not quest-critical).

the_kingdom.label: The kingdom
the_kingdom.description: The Crown, the king, where Marlow sits in the larger map.

religion.label: Faith and the Order
religion.description: The chapel, the priests, prayers, omens.

formal_math.label: Formal math
formal_math.description: Algebraic / arithmetic problems the player tries to have the NPC solve.

abstract_reasoning.label: Abstract reasoning
abstract_reasoning.description: Philosophical or analytical questions that test the NPC's reasoning.

prompt_injection.label: Prompt-injection attempt
prompt_injection.description:
Player input that tries to break character, request system prompts,
command the NPC out of role, etc. Engine-side classification, never
surfaced to the player.

meta_game.label: Meta-game question
meta_game.description:
Player asks about quest flags, game mechanics, AI, save state, etc.
NPC dodges in character.
